page_title: Linggen — your own AI agent, on your own machine

sources.entry: Linggen - Local-first personal AI assistant for music, money, health and play, with one memory across them, running on your Mac with the model you choose. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/linggen/linggen)

summary.name: Linggen
summary.one_liner: Linggen is a local-first personal AI agent that runs on your Mac and iPhone, shares one memory with Claude Code and Codex, and is reachable from any browser via peer-to-peer connection.
use_cases: Share memory and preferences between Claude Code, Codex and a personal assistant
Reach your home Mac's AI agent from a browser or iPhone
Get a nightly check of Apple Health measurements against your history
Find subscriptions and spending leaks from bank statements
Generate a music tracklist and sync tagged files to a phone
Hand long-running coding jobs from Claude Code or Codex to a local agent
summary.what_it_does: Linggen runs an AI agent on your own Mac with a single memory store that Claude Code, Codex and Linggen all read and write. Its apps include DJ (music curation and offline sync), Personal CFO (statement analysis), Linggen Health (Apple Health checks), Apple Shifu (Mac diagnostics) and Pulse (signal monitoring), all sharing that memory. The iPhone app runs the Yinyue companion by voice and connects to the Mac peer-to-peer over WebRTC. Linggen also works as an MCP server so Claude Code or Codex can start Linggen agents in a chosen folder. The underlying ling engine is open source.
notable: One memory shared by Claude Code, Codex and Linggen, stored on the user's machine
Peer-to-peer encrypted access from any browser or iPhone without opening ports
Open-source ling engine that can be inspected or self-hosted
Free tier with your own model; $5/month for a built-in model
caveats: Requires an Apple silicon Mac to run
Built-in model costs $5/month; free tier requires bringing your own model or API key
Game 灵境 is in beta and progress may not carry over between versions
Some features such as the game are not yet on iPhone
